description: This is a Swift class 'GatewayConnectivityCoordinator' responsible for managing connectivity state and endpoint information for a gateway component within the application. It handles lifecycle, state updates, and logging related to gateway endpoint connectivity.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: Handles gateway endpoint connectivity, manages state, and updates its information based on subscription stream.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the task to subscribe to endpoint state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Processes new endpoint state and updates internal properties accordingly.

methods.name: hostLabel(for:)
methods.description: Static utility method to generate a host label string from a URL.
